methodology.eligibility: First-party documentation or selected code must explicitly support direct advertising operations, budgets/bidding, targeting, advertising creatives/feed, advertising measurement/attribution, or media buying. Exclude generic agents, speculative adaptations and unrelated marketing. Mixed repositories qualify only for explicitly advertising-specific components.
methodology.ranking: Observed GitHub Stars descending within main/watch groups. Stars and Forks indicate public attention only; no adoption, maturity, ROAS or performance implication.
methodology.delta_semantics: Per-repository change versus 2026-11-05 observation; intervals 69.5–71.9 hours, not a 24-hour growth measure. First-time selections have no historical baseline.
methodology.push_semantics: pushed_at can include non-default branches; fixed default-branch HEAD and compare are recorded separately.
methodology.verification: Fetched current metadata, fixed-HEAD README and selected source. Verified SHA256 and Git blob SHA1. No candidates installed or run; no advertising accounts authorized or changed.
methodology.scope: Bounded public web/GitHub research, not an exhaustive whole-web or industry ranking.
